[RBND.1.2] Each of those four artifacts only has forensic or
operational meaning paired with the exact rules and dialect it
came from. Loading a profile produced under one DSC into an
engine that loaded a different DSC produces undefined RT
behavior. Replaying a trace against rules other than the rules
that produced it produces an incorrect debugging picture. The
"right" pairings are checkable; this spec defines the check.
